reviews.comment: Dr. Neuman is incredibly kind and approachable outside of class. He truly cares about his students and wants everyone to succeed. While I personally didn't find the content very engaging since it focused heavily on fossil identification and memorization, he is always willing to help and provides plenty of support for students who put in the effort.

amazing lecturer and very funny guy, i learned a lot about viruses in his class. not a lot of homework, exams are very open ended/memorization heavy but the final is optional and there is opportunity for extra credit. for honor credit we just had to write an extra essay, definitely recommend if you need to take an upper level bio honors class

His class is really enjoyable and he gives you the questions for the exam in advance at the beginning of the semester. Most of his exams are brain dumps and its just about how much knowledge you can remember. I would say its a free GPA booster as long as you do all the work and have him look over your answer for the exam questions.

Dr. Neuman is awesome. His love of viruses (or passion to hate viruses) is the foundation from which he teaches. He cracks jokes, simplifies complex processes, and is seemingly always cheerful. The class is a lot of work, but if you do the work, it is not hard to make a high grade due to the brain-dump exam style. He offers lots of extra-credit.

the most molecular detailed class I've taken- you learn SO much about virology/viruses! exams are frq- questions given on day 1, so prepare answers in advance! responses have to be in depth w/ molecular detail- use google + lecture videos! iclicker for attendance + bioinformatics extra credit project! final is optional

Phenomenal Lecturer, person, and caring person. Dr. Nueman has a great spontaneous and witty personality, I really enjoyed my time with him. I will say however for what the class is supposed to be, I feel like I didn't btain much of a challenge. Perfect class for a pre-med, but not for a graduate school hopeful.

I cannot speak any higher of this professor, he was absolutely amazing. I have never had a professor as caring, helpful, or understanding as him. He is very passionate about viruses and relates the topic to the real world very well. His class is not as easy as some said but if you put effort into studying for his exams this course can be an easy A.

Dr. Neuman is a great professor! Super understanding, offers a lot of extra credit, and wants to help you get an A! Taking notes can be helpful, but his tests are all lockdown browser with no camera. He walks through the assignments in class, and is pretty good at responding to emails

I've had Dr. Neuman for multiple courses & was in his research lab, and he is perhaps one of the best professors in the entire Biology dept.! He uses a flipped classroom style of teaching, going more in depth on questions or difficult material during lecture time. He uses relatable analogies to explain difficult concepts that helps many students.

Honestly one of the best profs I have ever had. Cares a lot about his students, offers extra credit, and is readily available for any questions. This course is easily one of the hardest I have taken in my undergrad, but Dr. Neuman explains everything very clearly. Very sweet and hilarious individual who is honestly a joy to be around.

Dr.Neuman is able to take a topic such as viral biology and make it extremely easy to understand while making you laugh at the same time. He is willing to answer any and all questions if it means you get a better understanding on the topic. This man is undoubtedly the gold standard by which all other professors should compare themselves too.

Hands down one of my favorite classes I've ever taken at Texas A&M. Dr. Neuman is one of the most passionate and knowledgeable individuals in his field and on top of that he is a great person. He really is rooting for your success and his exams are all written out with the prompts provided to you beforehand. No final for Honors section too!

He's great! He's able to make this very hard subject approachable and understandable. He encourages funny ways to remember the molecular bio bc he understands that its hard. He also acknowledges places where he lacks knowledge, which I respect. He does his exams in an essay/info-dump manner, so they allow you to really show what you know! Take Him!
